payload.title: File:Osteichthyan braincase evolution.webp
payload.artist_html: Jing Lu, Sam Giles, Matt Friedman & Min Zhu
payload.description_html: Simplified phylogeny showing braincase evolution in osteichthyans. a Single hyomandibular facet dorsal to the jugular vein, as shown in "Ligulalepis". b Double hyomandibular facet dorsal to the jugular vein, as shown in Ptyctolepis. c Double hyomandibular facet straddling the jugular vein, as shown in Qingmenodus. d Double hyomandibular facet dorsal to the jugular vein; supraotic cavity present, as shown in Eusthenopteron. Not drawn to scale
